connections.title: One operator, two roles: generator and observable
connections.invariant: the self-adjoint operator and its domain
connections.rewiring: read the same operator through its exponential for transport and through its spectral measure as an energy observable
connections.test: Check domain and self-adjointness once, then verify separately that the generated dynamics is unitary and that the spectral measure reproduces energy statistics.

connections.title: Schrodinger, Heisenberg, and path-integral representations
connections.rewiring: move time dependence between states and operators, or replace the propagator by an action-weighted integral
connections.test: Specify domains, measure, boundary conditions, and regularization; the formulations are connected only where they yield the same amplitudes or correlators.

connections.title: Carrier factorization defines locality
connections.invariant: the global state and algebraic predictions
connections.rewiring: change the tensor-product or algebraic subsystem decomposition and track which observables remain local
connections.test: State the subsystem algebra or tensor factorization explicitly; entanglement and locality claims are not invariant under arbitrary refactorization.

connections.title: Constraints define physical observables
connections.invariant: predictions on the physical state space
connections.rewiring: attach gauge or diffeomorphism closure before assigning outcome effects to physical observables
connections.test: Verify that candidate effects descend to the constrained or quotient state space; gauge-dependent quantities cannot be promoted directly to physical records.

connections.title: Boundary conditions are spectral control variables
connections.invariant: the differential operator family and probability conservation
connections.rewiring: change domain, boundary conditions, or asymptotic channels and follow the induced spectrum or transmission map
connections.test: A claimed connection must identify the operator domain and conserved flux; similar-looking wave equations with different domains need not have comparable spectra.

connections.title: Measurement, channels, and error correction share an instrument calculus
connections.rewiring: retain or discard the classical outcome of a quantum instrument, then condition a recovery channel on that outcome
connections.test: Check complete positivity, normalization, and recovery fidelity with a reference system; state-update rules alone are insufficient.

connections.title: Duality and simulation require an intertwining map
connections.invariant: a selected operator algebra and its correlators
connections.rewiring: encode one carrier in another and require the encoding to intertwine the relevant dynamics and observables
connections.test: Validate more than state overlap: compare a generating set of observables or correlators and report the approximation regime and error bounds.

interpretation: Connections are type-preserving constructor hypotheses. Route overlap is supporting corpus evidence, not proof of mathematical equivalence.
